findings.summary: vitest v2.1.9 silently ignores test.projects (v3-only API); integration suite and testTimeout 60000 are dead config.
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite using vitest@2 workspace: either set test.workspace=['./vitest.unit.config.ts','./vitest.integration.config.ts'] with two sibling configs, or split into two top-level configs. Verify with `pnpm exec vitest list` showing both suites.

findings.summary: exports points to './src/index.ts'; Node cannot load .ts at runtime, so production builds of apps/api (compiled JS) will fail to resolve @medbridge/contracts.
findings.suggested_fix: Either drop emitDeclarationOnly and emit JS to dist/ then set exports={import:'./dist/index.js',types:'./dist/index.d.ts'}, or document this as TS-source-only (dev+test only) and adjust apps/api build to bundle contracts.

findings.summary: build script copies src/db/migrations into dist, but that directory does not exist yet (lands in later wave); script will fail if run before migrations wave.
findings.suggested_fix: Acceptable as a forward declaration; add `mkdir -p dist/db && [ -d src/db/migrations ] && cp -r ...` guard once wave-5 lands, or accept that `build` only runs in CI after migrations exist.
